about: The audit's rule catalogue. Each rule has an id, a severity (error, warning, info), a scope (the part of the site it reads), what it checks, and a hint for fixing it. The checks live in mde/audit/engine.py under the same ids; thresholds and banned strings are set here.

banned_public_strings.why: a model name in public text
the old combined site name; titles end with '· Mimir'
a feature described as coming that has shipped

rules.title: Duplicate slug
rules.hint: Slugs must be unique across every seed file.

rules.title: Missing required field
rules.hint: Every work needs slug, title, medium and (except channels) a year.

rules.title: Implausible year
rules.hint: Check the year against the source; negative years are for ancient works.

rules.title: Implausible length
rules.hint: Runtime, playtime and page counts must be positive and within range.

rules.title: Unknown tag
rules.hint: Terms must exist in taxonomy/taxonomy.json.

rules.title: Tag strength outside 0 to 1
rules.hint: Strengths are fractions.

rules.title: Summary too short, too long or a placeholder
rules.hint: One or two spoiler-free sentences; no placeholder text.

rules.title: Possible duplicate work (same title, year and medium)
rules.hint: Merge or distinguish the two records.

rules.title: Popularity tier missing or outside 1 to 5
rules.hint: Imported works get tiers from Wikidata link counts.

rules.title: Invalid country or language code
rules.hint: Countries are two capital letters (ISO 3166); languages two or three lowercase letters.

rules.title: Classified work without a parents' guide
rules.hint: Add advisories, or mark them 0 where there is nothing to flag.

rules.title: Summary but no moods or themes
rules.hint: A summarised work should be classified beyond genre.

rules.title: Well-known work still without a summary
rules.hint: These are the next works to write up; they stay noindex until then.

rules.title: Cover without licence or attribution
rules.hint: Every image record needs licence and attribution text.

rules.title: Well-known work without a real cover
rules.hint: Run mde.ingest.reference_covers or add a licensed image.

rules.title: Relationship names an unknown work
rules.hint: Both ends of a relationship must exist.

rules.title: Taxonomy term has an unknown parent or duplicate key
rules.hint: Parents must be genre terms; keys are dimension:slug.

rules.title: Tag used by no work
rules.hint: Fine for new terms; remove if unused for long.

rules.title: Synonym claimed by two terms
rules.hint: The intent parser matches whole phrases; one synonym must map to one term.

rules.title: Shelf rule uses an unknown tag or duplicate slug
rules.hint: Check any_tags and all_tags against the taxonomy.

rules.title: Shelf smaller than the minimum
rules.hint: A shelf below min_works is hidden from the site.

rules.title: Gap totals do not match the works
rules.hint: Re-run the gap tally after a fill-in batch.

rules.title: Provenance names an unknown work
rules.hint: Remove the stale record or restore the work.

rules.title: Observance or programme invalid (date, rule tag)
rules.hint: Dates are MM-DD; rule tags must exist.

rules.title: YouTube video without its channel
rules.hint: Videos name a channel work in attributes.channel.

rules.title: Audiobook record names an unknown work
rules.hint: Keys are work slugs.

rules.title: Blog post invalid (duplicate slug, bad date, empty body)
rules.hint: Slugs unique; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.title: Banned or outdated string in public text
rules.hint: See params.banned_public_strings.

rules.title: Stale count in text
rules.hint: Counts of works, countries and languages must match the catalogue.

rules.title: Legal page placeholder still to be filled
rules.hint: Each [[...]] in demo/legal.cjs is something the company must supply before the page is final.

rules.title: Page missing title, description, canonical or exactly one H1
rules.hint: Every built page needs all four.

rules.title: Broken internal link
rules.hint: Link targets must exist in the built site.

rules.title: Sitemap lists a missing or noindex page
rules.hint: Only indexable pages belong in the sitemap.

rules.title: Indexable page missing from the sitemap
rules.hint: Add it to the sitemap build.

rules.title: Title or description too long
rules.hint: Titles up to 70 characters, descriptions up to 165.
